claim_scope: One-record train-only CPU online adaptation smoke. The adapter reads exactly two adjacent onset frames; future train truth is opened only after adapted coefficients are serialized. No validation, test_id, generalization, runtime, or target claim.
hypothesis: Changing only the correction span from rejected branch-trunk modes to the oracle-qualified top-64 physical-head channel modes will allow the same two-onset-plus-DG-flux ridge objective to reduce future-field relative L2 by at least 0.1% on train_marmousi_00260.
expected_mechanism: Physical-head channels directly synthesize local pressure structure and passed the 1% oracle-capacity gate, so the unchanged causal online objective may select a future-useful direction inside this stronger span.
conceptual_variable: correction basis only; parent, sample, online objective, ridge, trust cap, precision, and evaluation are unchanged
primary_metric: Post-seal future-field relative-L2 improvement over the unadapted update-13650 prediction.
failure_signal: Reject on binding drift, invalid two-frame access, non-finite tensors, online-objective rejection, future improvement below 0.1%, process failure, or any validation/test_id access.

data.future_truth_policy: serialize adapted coefficients and access audit before opening later train frames

adaptation.basis: top-64 energy physical-head channel contributions, hard-free-surface projected, phase rotated, Gram-whitened, and parent-norm scaled

rollback: Preserve the update-13650 parent and all oracle/failed artifacts. If the post-seal future gate fails, retain the unadapted prediction and stop online-objective tuning on this reused development record.
